name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Paradeep Phosphates Limited is a manufacturer of non-urea fertilizers  and India’s second largest private sector phosphatic company. The company is engaged in manufacturing, trading, distribution, and sales of a variety of complex fertilizers such as DAP, three grades of Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium (namely NPK-10, NPK-12, and NP-20), Zypmite, Phospho-gypsum, and Hydroflorosilicic Acid.[1]
keyPoints:
Promoter
The company is promoted by Zuari Agro Chemicals and OCP Group of Morocco, jointly holding 56.1% through Zuari Maroc Phosphates Pvt Ltd. [1] The OCP Group is one of the world's largest phosphatic players, having control over 70% of the world's known phosphate reserves, with a revenue of over $10 billion. [2]
